procedure.rule: Both platforms, each Polymarket contract used once, Kalshi volume at most 15 million contracts and Polymarket volume at most 5 million dollars. Political: party, state, and year agree. Sports: championship-winner markets, team name and championship year agree, then the same seed-42 split (3 above the category median, 2 at or below). Economic: same unemployment or payrolls month, smallest listed bucket on each side, same seed-42 split.
